case_title.quote: SANTOSH S/O SHANKAR PAWAR v. STATE OF MAHARASHTRA

number_of_accused.reason: Only one accused is tried and appeals.

accused_gender.reason: The accused is the husband, so male.

accused_age.reason: No age is given for the accused.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community is mentioned.

accused_occupation.quote: The appellant and the deceased were earning their livelihood by doing daily wages work.

accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: Due to poverty, the deceased alongwith the accused was residing adjacent to her parental house

victim_age.reason: No age is given for the victim.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the marriage of the appellant Santosh Pawar and deceased Saraswatibai was solemnized on 17.6.2005

offence_category.quote: conviction of the appellant under Section 302 IPC

statutory_provisions.quote: FIR was registered for the offence under Section 307 IPC... the FIR was altered to Section 302 IPC

aggravating_circumstances.quote: Within three months of her marriage, the deceased died of burn injuries.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: it cannot be considered as a mitigating factor
mitigating_circumstances.reason: The court rejected the mitigating claims.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced him to undergo life imprisonment and imposed a fine of Rs.1000/- with default clause to suffer rigorous imprisonment for two months

high_court_outcome.quote: the said appeal was dismissed confirming the conviction and sentence

final_outcome.quote: the appeal fails and is dismissed

offence_finally_established.quote: affirming the conviction of the appellant under Section 302 IPC

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence, so no fixed term.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary, but replace 'He', 'his' and similar with 'the accused' to avoid gendered pronouns.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the s.302 punishment.

premeditation_planning.quote: absence of pre-meditation will not reduce the offence of murder

motive.reason: Suspicion of infidelity is the motive.
